tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ensure a secure and professional installation for your IT equipment with Mounting Screws and Cage Nuts for Server Rack. Designed for standard 19-inch server racks and cabinets, this hardware kit is ideal for mounting servers, switches, patch panels, PDUs, KVM, UPS, and networking devices.


Made from hardened steel with zinc plating, these rack screws and cage nuts offer excellent corrosion resistance and long-lasting durability, making them suitable for data centers, office server rooms, and telecom environments in Bangladesh. Easy to install and universally compatible with leading rack brands like Cisco, HP, Dell, IBM, and APC, this mounting kit is a must-have accessory for IT professionals.


Technical Specification

Product Type: Mounting Screws & Cage Nuts Set

Compatibility: Standard 19-inch server racks & network cabinets

Screw Size: M6 x 16mm (standard rackmount size)

Nut Type: M6 cage nut (snap-in type for square holes)

Material: Hardened Steel

Finish/Coating: Zinc Plated / Black Oxide (anti-rust, anti-corrosion)

Head Type: Phillips Pan Head / Cross Slot

Thread Size: M6 metric standard

Application: Mounting rack servers, switches, routers, patch panels, PDUs, UPS, and accessories

Compatibility Brands: Dell, HP, Cisco, IBM, APC, D-Link, Huawei, Toten and  Generic 19-inch racks
